subject: CEN-G6 / CEN-G6b: the long-term weight trajectory under the maximal-block, pseudorandom and minimal schedules
format: one line per block, 'H <block>, BW <weight>, EMBW <effective median>, LTBW <long-term weight>'; three runs, each restarting at H 0 with both windows full of the zone

schedule.weight: 2 * EMBW, the largest block the limit admits
the generator's LCG plus a sine, from 90 bytes up

windows: the generator's: short 100 blocks (the shipped short window), long 5000 blocks (the C++ test's TEST_LONG_TERM window, not the shipped 100000; the rule takes its window from its caller)
embw_column: the generator clamps the short-term median below at the zone; the rule clamps it at the long-term effective median (CEN-G6b), as the C++ does, so the rule's effective median is max(EMBW, LTEM). compare.py never compared this column for that reason
supersedes: tests/block_weight compare.py (the C++ block_weight binary against this generator)
